Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From a740a423c36932695b01a3e920f697bc55b05fec Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Thomas Gleixner <tglx@linutronix.de>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2020 14:03:42 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] genirq/debugfs: Add missing sanity checks to interrupt
 injection

Interrupts cannot be injected when the interrupt is not activated and when
a replay is already in progress.

Fixes: 536e2e34bd00 ("genirq/debugfs: Triggering of interrupts from userspace")
Signed-off-by: Thomas Gleixner <tglx@linutronix.de>
Acked-by: Marc Zyngier <maz@kernel.org>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/20200306130623.500019114@linutronix.de

diff --git a/kernel/irq/debugfs.c b/kernel/irq/debugfs.c
index a949bd39e343..d44c8fd17609 100644
--- a/kernel/irq/debugfs.c
+++ b/kernel/irq/debugfs.c
@@ -206,8 +206,15 @@ static ssize_t irq_debug_write(struct file *file, const char __user *user_buf,
 		chip_bus_lock(desc);
 		raw_spin_lock_irqsave(&desc->lock, flags);
 
-		if (irq_settings_is_level(desc) || desc->istate & IRQS_NMI) {
-			/* Can't do level nor NMIs, sorry */
+		/*
+		 * Don't allow injection when the interrupt is:
+		 *  - Level or NMI type
+		 *  - not activated
+		 *  - replaying already
+		 */
+		if (irq_settings_is_level(desc) ||
+		    !irqd_is_activated(&desc->irq_data) ||
+		    (desc->istate & (IRQS_NMI | IRQS_REPLAY))) {
 			err = -EINVAL;
 		} else {
 			desc->istate |= IRQS_PENDING;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `kernel/irq/debugfs.c`**
- Added additional sanity checks in the `irq_debug_write` function to prevent interrupt injection under certain conditions.
- The new checks ensure that interrupts cannot be injected if:
  - The interrupt is of level or NMI type.
  - The interrupt is not activated.
  - A replay of the interrupt is already in progress.
- The error handling for invalid conditions has been updated to return `-EINVAL` if any of the new conditions are met.

### Relationships
The modifications in `kernel/irq/debugfs.c` are directly related to the bug fix identified by the commit hash `536e2e34bd00`, which introduced the ability to trigger interrupts from userspace. The new sanity checks enhance the robustness of this feature by ensuring that interrupts are only injected when it is safe to do so, thereby preventing potential issues that could arise from injecting interrupts in invalid states.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
if (irq_settings_is_level(desc) || desc->istate & IRQS_NMI) {
```
Reason:
This statement checks if the interrupt is of level type or if it is an NMI (Non-Maskable Interrupt), but it does not verify if the interrupt is activated or if a replay is already in progress. This oversight allows for the possibility of injecting interrupts in invalid states, leading to system instability or unexpected behavior.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
if (irq_settings_is_level(desc) ||
    !irqd_is_activated(&desc->irq_data) ||
    (desc->istate & (IRQS_NMI | IRQS_REPLAY))) {
```
Reason:
This updated condition adds necessary sanity checks to ensure that interrupts are only injected when they are activated and not during a replay or if they are of level or NMI type. This prevents invalid interrupt injection scenarios, thereby enhancing system stability and preventing unexpected behavior.
